_comment: An audit log entry object with the extra guild_id key. action_type 12 is CHANNEL_DELETE. user_id is the actor — the only attribution Discord gives for a channel deletion, since CHANNEL_DELETE itself names no one. Delivered only to bots holding VIEW_AUDIT_LOG, and only under the GUILD_MODERATION intent (1<<2). `id` is a snowflake, so it carries the moment of the deletion and is stable across a RESUME redelivery.
